info.name: FCC Area and Census Block API
Get Census Block FIPS by Latitude and Longitude

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees or DMS format. Range: -90 to 90. Examples: 38.26 or 38:15:36N

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees or DMS format. Range: -180 to 180. Examples: -77.51 or 77:30:36W

params.name: censusYear
params.description: Census year for results. Valid values: 2010, 2020 (default)

params.name: showall
params.description: If the coordinate lies on the boundary of multiple geographies, use showall=true to return the complete list.

items.docs: Returns the US Census Bureau Census Block FIPS code, county FIPS code, and state FIPS code for a given latitude and longitude. Also returns the associated US State and County names.
